title: Sheet Number Authority Resolver and CDE Pre-Registration Gate
purpose: Resolve the applicable sheet/drawing numbering authority, classify document meaning independently from identifier syntax, and prevent ambiguous or unauthorized identities from entering a governed CDE document register.

steps.action: Collect governing evidence and determine whether a governed document-number convention applies.
steps.on_missing: Do not assume simplified numbering until the authority sweep is complete.

steps.action: Resolve numbering profile by precedence: law/regulation; contract/appointment; appointing-party/authority requirements; incorporated external/national standard; project information standard/EIR; BEP/CDE configuration; TIVERIT fallback.

Classify the sheet/drawing semantic record: project stage, work condition, building/volume, zone/area, level/location, discipline, information form, content class, content subtype, sequence, status/suitability, revision, and title.
Apply the selected profile to generate or validate the required document identity without changing the underlying semantic classification.
Run pre-registration validation against the selected authority/profile and CDE-required metadata.
If validation passes, permit technical registration in the CDE. Registration execution does not create or alter underlying approval/acceptance authority.
After formal registration or issue, route identity changes through governed document-control change/supersede procedure and preserve traceability.

failure_conditions: A TIVERIT fallback number is generated while a higher-precedence project convention is known or unresolved.
Aconex configuration is treated as authority without a governing project basis.
Project stage is inferred from demolition/existing/proposed condition.
An enlarged floor plan is silently treated as a detail solely because a numbering range uses the same digit.
A document is first registered with an unresolved classification or number and expected to be casually renamed later.
A Miral/UAE profile is activated without curated governing evidence.
